name: Hardings Play Area, Panshanger
description: Play area on the Panshanger estate, between Hardings, Little Hardings and The Meadow, a short walk behind the Moors Walk shops and Panshanger Community Centre. It's mapped on OpenStreetMap but isn't in Welwyn Hatfield Council's play area finder, so we don't yet know who runs it or what equipment it has.
